name: Deep Sea Scale
description: A hold item that raises the Sp. Def of Clamperl.

gifts.note: After Badge 7, trade him the Scanner. Once you have the Mossdeep Gym badge (Badge 7), talk to Capt. Stern in Slateport Harbor while carrying the Scanner. He trades it for your choice of the Deep Sea Tooth or the Deep Sea Scale. There is only one Scanner, so you get only one of them. The Scanner is in a locked room on the Abandoned Ship's lower deck, reached with Dive.
